gaps: Every breath-one item sorted the lead time by who held it (a counterparty, a queue, a rule, a growing thing, a chain) and assumed the lead time ran on its own, independent of the runway it had to fit inside. Sharpening Partner meeting against runway-illusions' investor who waits produced a lead time that is a function of the remaining runway, so the floor is a fixed point and not a number. Sharpening Understudy's fake, the spare never exercised, against Gestation showed that a finished spare decays and is itself on a lead time, and that where elapsed time is the ingredient nothing can buy it, only start it earlier. Changed question for breath two: when can the replacement's clock run relative to the source's, and what does running it do to the source.
accepted: Understudy: the replacement is finished before it is needed and waits, as the standby generator, the theatre's understudy, the second goalkeeper, the named successor, the spare transformer in the yard, so the lead time is zero and the floor drops to the wind-down bill alone; the lead time was run to completion in advance, the carrier is an idle copy and its upkeep, it is shortened to nothing at the price of carrying a thing that earns nothing, and it is faked by the spare never exercised, the generator that will not start, the backup never once restored, the understudy who never rehearsed, so the drill and not the spare is the purchase, since a spare's lead time is unknown until it is called; not survival-floors' Kept on call, which is the seller's retainer, since here the operator owns the copy and no other hand can call it.

Longest-lead part: a replacement that must be built has a lead time set by its slowest component rather than by its labour, as the rebuilt substation waiting two years on a transformer, the house after the fire waiting on the permit, the ship on its engine, the clinic on its licensed pharmacist, so the floor is the longest single lead among the parts and the rest of the build hides inside it; the carrier is whichever supplier's or office's queue is longest, it is shortened by stockpiling that one part or holding a pre-approved plan while the labour is engineered down, as Toyota cut a die change from a day to minutes and the inventory that had covered it disappeared, and it is faked by the insurance cheque counted as the house; not Understudy, which is the whole thing finished, since here only the slowest part is bought ahead and the build still runs.

Gestation: the replacement must grow, as the crop that takes a season, the herd that takes a gestation and a weaning, timber, a barrel's years, a residency's years before citizenship, so the lead time is a count of elapsed time no money converts; the carrier is the thing's own rate of becoming, it is shortened only by buying the thing at a later stage, a heifer rather than a calf, a running business rather than a plan, which is buying someone else's elapsed time, and it is faked by the seed in the ground counted as the crop; not Staggered stand, which is the purchase of starting, since Gestation is the reason the stand is the only purchase, and not Calendar with nothing in it, since here the time is an ingredient and something is growing in it.

Clean months: a replacement that is a standing, a credit line, a licence, a lease, arrives only after the counterparty has watched a required run of periods, as the bank that wants two years of filed accounts, the credit file's seven years after a discharge, the reinstatement after a suspension, the landlord who wants references from the last address; the lead time is the counterparty's evidence rule, the carrier is a record kept in a form the counterparty reads, it is shortened by a guarantor who lends their own record, a co-signer, a vouching institution, and it is faked by the shell with a new name, which is Gestation's later-stage purchase applied to a record and is fraud; adds to who-can-be-bound's time to acquire a hold the guarantor as the purchase; not Gestation, where the thing itself grows and no one need watch, since here a witness must have been kept.

Once a year: the market for the replacement opens on a period longer than many runways, as the academic hiring season, the football transfer window, the visa lottery, open enrolment, the harvest, the school year, so the lead time is the distance to the next window plus the window's own processing and the floor is quantized, a day late costing a cycle; the carrier is the window's calendar, it is shortened by nothing but timing the start, and it is faked by the application filed out of window, which is in the pile and in no queue; not Partner meeting, whose cadence is shorter than the runway and repeats inside it, since here one missed date is the whole death.

Place in line: the replacement arrives when others leave or when an event no one schedules occurs, as the transplant list, the social-housing list, the visa quota, the berth, so the lead time is a position moved by others' exits or by a priority score and the wait has a distribution and no date; the carrier is the queue's rule of order, it is shortened by a side channel, the living donor, the private lane, or by a rush fee where one is sold, whose existence tells the operator that the wait was a queue and prices the floor, and it is faked by 'on the list' read as a date; not Once a year, where the date is known and the wait is to it, since here the date is unknown and the only knowable thing is the place.

Chain's longest link: the replacement's arrival waits on a chain of other people's replacements, as the housing chain where no one completes until the last buyer's buyer does, the kidney-exchange chain, the transfer that waits on the selling club signing its own replacement, the sublet that waits on the subletter's new lease, so the lead time is the longest path through others' lead times and one link's failure resets the whole; the carrier is the chain's contingency clauses, it is shortened by a chain-breaker, a cash buyer, a bridging loan, an altruistic donor who starts a chain with no link behind, and it is faked by an offer accepted subject to chain; not Place in line, where others' exits move you, since here others' arrivals hold you.

Release at both ends: the replacement has said yes but is held by its own commitments, and the operator is held by theirs, as the hire with three months' notice elsewhere, the tenant with a lease to run, the contractor booked until spring, the player whose club must release, and on the near side the notice the operator must serve; the lead time is the sum of two releases written in contracts with third parties, the carrier is those contracts, it is shortened by buying a release, a transfer fee, a garden-leave buyout, or by drawing from the bench of the uncommitted, and it is faked by the signed offer with no start date; not Partner meeting, where the decision is not yet made, since here the decision is made and the body is not free.

Partner meeting: the replacement arrives on the counterparty's decision calendar rather than the operator's, as the fund's Monday partner meeting, the hiring committee that sits monthly, the credit committee that meets quarterly, the admissions round, the diocese's placement, so the lead time is the cadence of their meetings times the number of gates the decision must pass; the carrier is the counterparty's own process, it is shortened by a pre-signed paper, a standing term sheet, a pre-approved line, an offer held open, whose own fake is that the writer re-decides at exercise, as the credit line reviewed when drawn, and it is faked by the verbal yes, which is a decision not yet on their calendar; adds to runway-illusions' Watched burn, which reprices the terms, the arrival, since a counterparty can be willing and slow.

Ramp inside the floor: the replacement is present but not yet the thing, as the hire's six months to productivity, the new surgeon's first hundred cases, the transplanted kidney's weeks to function, the new supplier's qualification, so the lead time continues past arrival and the floor sits above the start date; the carrier is learning or integration on the operator's own premises, it is shortened by overlap, running the ramp while the old source still works, which costs paying two and requires the old source to host its successor, and it is faked by headcount filled; not Release at both ends, which ends when the body arrives, since here arrival is where the wait begins.

Bridge: a degraded replacement with no lead time exists because the true one has a lead time, as the locum, the temp agency, the bridging loan, the rental car, dialysis, the interim chief, the tarp on the roof, so the purchase is not a shorter wait but a longer survivable one, and the bridge's price is the market's quote of the floor; the carrier is a market in stopgaps priced by the hour, it is shortened by nothing, since it does not shorten, and it is faked by the bridge that becomes the crossing, the temp of nine years, the interim of four; not a survival floor, which holds the operator, since the bridge holds the function at a worse rate, and not Understudy, which is the true thing waiting.

residue.item: Rush lane: where a paid expedite exists, the wait was a queue and the fee is the floor's price.
residue.why: Merged into Place in line as its shortener and into the Place in line → Gestation edge as the fork's test; on its own it is a detector of which item one is in, not a lead time.

residue.item: Die change: the lead time between products inside one's own plant, covered by inventory until Toyota engineered it down to minutes.
residue.why: Merged into Longest-lead part as the contrast case: the labour side of a build can be engineered down and the inventory covering it disappears, while the slowest bought part cannot; the mechanism is one item read at its two ends.

residue.item: Admission delay: the search cannot start until the operator has said the source is dying, and the saying is deferred.
residue.why: Rejected: mood, not mechanism; not yet separable from nerve, which runway-illusions also declined to admit, and it names no carrier outside the operator.

residue.item: Customers' lead time: the time it takes those who depend on you to replace you is a floor under you.
residue.why: Rejected: runway-illusions' Too expensive to let die already holds it as the counterparties' replacement cost; this map keeps the operator's own replacement.

residue.item: Move time: the runway lengthened to the time it takes to relocate to where the skill sells.
residue.why: Rejected: runway-illusions' Any-town skill carries it, with the discount at the far end; nothing is added by reading it as a lead time.

residue.item: Replacement in trials: the search for a replacement is a count of attempts with a hit rate, not a duration.
residue.why: Rejected: runway-illusions' Runway in shots holds the unit change; what the lead-time reading adds is only whether trials may run at once, which became No-shop in breath two.

gate: declared modality, recognizable distinction, defensible seriation and conditional relations
limits: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy of hiring, fundraising, or supply chains; a real replacement runs several of these in series (a hire is Partner meeting, then Release at both ends, then Ramp inside the floor), and the list claims no coverage.

The seriation is an itinerary of when the replacement's clock may run relative to the source's, not a ranking of length, cost, or danger; map edges are conditional authored claims, the fixed-point floor is analytical, and the slowdown for the visibly dying is observed for the long-term unemployed and extended to firms and sellers by analogy.

The illustrative cases (two-year transformer leads, housing and kidney-exchange chains, term-sheet exclusivity, the forester's stand of every age, Toyota's die changes, pre-need contracts) are simplified to one mechanism each and are not claims about specific histories, firms, or jurisdictions.

Lead times on stopping (the notice on the operator's own commitments, the wind-down bill) and delays in reaching money already owned belong to runway-illusions; here only the wait for an arrival. The customers' lead time to replace the operator is Too expensive to let die's carrier read from the other side and is out.

Staggered stand's claim holds only where no market in later stages exists; where heifers or running businesses can be bought, the stand is one option among two, and Gestation says which. The operator's own delay in admitting the source is dying was left out as mood rather than mechanism, as runway-illusions also left it.
seed: A lead time that lengthens as the runway shortens, so that the death is where the two curves cross and not where either is measured.

gaps: The changed question yielded the loop the sequence cannot show (Seeking is telling with Rising floor), one purchase for elapsed time (Staggered stand), a wait that is a sentence (Calendar with nothing in it), a serialization sold as a cure (No-shop), and a lead time that cannot begin until the death (Starts at the funeral), which put the map's far edge at survival-floors' near edge. The territory pointer stands and the slug is kept; the of-sentence now asks, for each item, when its clock can run relative to the source's, and the seriation answers the live question in five grades rather than the pointer's two: bought finished, pre-started only, run at exercise on another's clock, run only inside the dying runway and acting on it, and unable to begin until the death.
accepted: Staggered stand: where the lead time is elapsed time itself, the only purchase is a stand of replacements started at every age, as the forester who plants a cohort every year so a cutting is always ripe, the vintner's barrels of every vintage, the rancher's heifers behind the cows, the firm that is always ramping one hire and the bench of juniors behind a senior; the carrier is the carrying cost of every cohort at once, it is shortened by nothing further, since starting is the whole purchase, and it is faked by the stand with a missing cohort, the hiring freeze that leaves no one to promote ten years later, the forest with no thirty-year-olds, which is invisible until the year the absent cohort would have matured; not Understudy, which is one finished copy, since a stand is bought by starting and not by finishing, and only a stand can replace a replacement.

Calendar with nothing in it: the lead time is a wait a rule imposes in which nothing grows and nothing is witnessed, as the year between filing and decree, the interval before a bankrupt may file again, the non-compete's twelve months, the season a suspended driver must sit out; the carrier is the rule and its issuing authority, the wait starts on the operator's own filing or leaving, it is shortened only by a waiver or by a jurisdiction that wrote a shorter one, never by a price, and it is faked by starting under the table, which converts the wait into a risk; not Gestation, where the time is an ingredient, and not Clean months, where the time is evidence, since here the time is the sentence, and the wait's end produces exactly what its start had.

No-shop: the counterparty's paper forbids running the search in parallel, as the term sheet's exclusivity period, the lock-out agreement, the exclusive listing, the visa system that cancels an application when a second is filed, so the lead time becomes serial and each failed candidate costs its whole exclusivity rather than its share of a spread; the carrier is the clause, it is shortened by a short exclusivity or a break fee, and it is faked by the non-binding term sheet whose one binding clause is the no-shop; the exploding offer is the same serialization from the other end, forbidding the wait rather than the search; adds to runway-illusions' Runway in shots, which counts trials, the rule that decides whether trials may run at once.

Seeking is telling: the search for a replacement is visible to the source and shortens it, as the employer who learns of the interviews, the investor who hears the founder pitched the fund next door, the landlord who sees the boxes, the client who learns the firm is prospecting, so a lead time that must be run inside the runway shortens the runway it runs in; the carrier is the source's sight of the search, it is shortened by a discreet channel, the headhunter, the banker's confidential process, the exploratory conversation, and it is faked by the confidential process in a town of one industry; not Watched burn, where the source sees the burn, since here the source sees the cure.

Rising floor: the lead time lengthens as the runway shortens, as the unemployed are hired slower than the employed, the firm at three months raises slower than at twelve, the seller with a closing date gets fewer offers, so the floor is not the lead time measured from strength but the fixed point where remaining runway equals the lead time at that remaining runway, and it sits higher; the carrier is the counterparty's reading of the remaining clock, it is shortened by starting from strength, before the clock is legible, and it is faked by the lead time quoted by someone who ran it from strength, since 'it took me six weeks' was measured at another point on the curve; observed in labour markets, analytical elsewhere; not Watched burn, which holds the buyer who waits for the price, since here even the willing arrive slower and the floor is a fixed point rather than a number.

Starts at the funeral: some lead times cannot begin until the source is dead, as the insurance claim after the fire, the widow's pension after the certificate, the credit that rebuilds only after the discharge, the remarriage after the decree, the acquirer who buys the assets only from the liquidator, so the floor is not above zero but a gap after it and no runway can contain it; the carrier is a rule that makes the death the trigger, it is shortened by a paper filed before, the pre-need contract, the will, the standby letter of credit, the advance directive, whose fake is the paper the trigger itself revokes; the gap is what survival-floors' floors bridge, and this is the map's far edge, where the lead time leaves the runway.

residue.item: Exploding offer: a replacement that arrives with its own expiry shorter than the alternatives' arrival, so parallel search is forced to a serial choice.
residue.why: Merged into No-shop as the same serialization imposed from the other end, forbidding the wait rather than the search; the two differ in which half of parallelism they destroy, not in what they let the operator do about it.

residue.item: Missing cohort: the gap in an age structure that appears as a death only in the year the absent cohort would have matured.
residue.why: Merged into Staggered stand as its fake; it is the stand read for its hole, and clocks-that-are-not-clocks already reads durations off structures.

residue.item: Drill: the rehearsal that turns a paper spare into a real one by discovering its lead time.
residue.why: Merged into Understudy as the cure of its fake; on its own it is the purchase of knowledge about a lead time rather than a lead time.

residue.item: Search from strength: the replacement is sought while the source is healthy so the counterparty reads no clock.
residue.why: Merged into Rising floor as its shortener; as an item it was advice, and its mechanism is the rise it avoids.

residue.item: Pre-need paper: the will, the standby letter of credit, the pre-need funeral contract, filed before the death so a post-death lead time can start on the day.
residue.why: Merged into Starts at the funeral as its shortener, with the fake that the trigger revokes the paper; the paper does not move the trigger, it only removes the search after it.

neighbors.separating_case: A founder who runs the raise through a banker's confidential process at three months of runway: no employee, customer, or landlord learns of the search, so Seeking is telling is defeated, yet every fund that opens the data room reads three months off the bank statement and slows, so Rising floor bites unaltered. In reverse, an employee with a year of savings whose manager hears of an interview: no counterparty reads a short clock yet, so no floor rises, but the source shortens. Each occurs without the other; the loop is when both do, and the fixed point belongs to Rising floor alone.

checks.boundary_case: The remaining term on the operator's own lease, or the severance owed, is a tempting nonmember and is out: it is time the operator must pay for while stopping, not time the operator must wait for an arrival, and runway-illusions' Burn you cannot put down already holds it. The net-sixty invoice is out for the same reason on the other side, since it delays reaching money already owned rather than the arrival of a replacement. A member is a wait for something to arrive that is not yet the operator's.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a loop the sequence conceals: Seeking is telling and Rising floor sit as neighbours on the itinerary, but the two edges between them say that a visible search shortens the source and a shorter source slows the search, and that the rise forces an early start exactly when seeking tells most, so the floor is the fixed point where the loop settles. It shows an incompatibility at Ramp inside the floor → Seeking is telling: overlap requires the old source to host its successor, so past that point one cannot both overlap and keep the search discreet. It shows a passage between levels at Rising floor → Starts at the funeral, where the floor moves from a height above zero to a gap after it and the operator leaves this map for survival-floors. It shows a fork with a test at Place in line → Gestation, decided by whether anyone sells a shorter wait. It shows a dependency at Understudy → Staggered stand, where the lead time bought entirely ahead rests on one that can only be pre-started. And it shows a recruitment at Partner meeting → No-shop, where the paper that shortens the committee's wait carries the clause that serializes the search.
checks.target_preserved: Self-read only. Each item names a distinct lead time, a distinct carrier, a distinct shortener, and a distinct fake, and the strange members are kept as mechanisms and not softened into advice about planning ahead: a purchase that is a drill rather than a spare, a stand of every age as the only purchase for elapsed time, a wait that is a sentence, a floor that is a fixed point rather than a number, a serialization sold as a cure, and a lead time that cannot begin until the death.

seed: Whether the fixed point of Rising floor can be seen from outside by the counterparty as well: if a fund can compute where a founder's remaining runway meets the fund's own cadence, it can wait to exactly that point, so the rising floor is not only read off the operator but set by the reader, and the map would need an item where the counterparty chooses the floor.
next_crossfield_opening: Connect Staggered stand with clocks-that-are-not-clocks: an age structure with a hole is a clock that reads the year of a future death, and the question is whether every real-time lead time leaves such a structure behind, so that lead-time floors could be read years ahead off cohorts, vintages, and tenure tables without any quote of the lead time itself.

seed: The algebra the map uses but never states: which lead times add along a path (Release at both ends is a sum of two, and a hire is Partner meeting plus Release plus Ramp in series), which take the maximum (Longest-lead part over parts, Chain's longest link over a path through others), which take the minimum across candidates (parallel search across committees), which multiply (Partner meeting's cadence times its gates), and which convert one operator into another (No-shop turns a minimum across candidates into a sum; a discreet channel keeps the minimum; a window collapses every candidate to one date). The boundary claim admits that a real replacement runs several items in series and claims no coverage of that; a single item or a note that assigns each item its operator would let an operator compute a floor from the map instead of reading it, and would say exactly why No-shop is the most expensive clause on the list.
